title: App version info for support/debugging
description: Small addition so a warden reporting an issue (or the developer supporting them remotely) can quickly see which build they're running. A one-line version string somewhere reachable, not a full About screen.
acceptanceCriteria: More tab shows the app's versionName/versionCode somewhere visible (e.g. a footer line)
Value updates automatically per build - not a hardcoded string that goes stale

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.
Starting - a footer line under the More tab's menu, sourced from BuildConfig so it tracks the build rather than a literal.

Enabled android.buildFeatures.buildConfig and added a centred footer line under the More tab's menu reading R.string.more_version with BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME and BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE, so it tracks whatever the build produced rather than a literal that goes stale. Strings added in en and hi. gradlew compileDebugKotlin green.

PASS. AC1: the More tab shows 'Lodgy v0.1 (build 1)' as a footer line under the menu, visible without scrolling. AC2: not hardcoded - MoreScreen.kt:128 reads BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME and BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE, which match app/build.gradle.kts versionName '0.1' / versionCode 1, so it tracks the build automatically. Also localises correctly - renders as 'Lodgy v0.1 (build 1)' with a translated 'build' word in Hindi.
